questions.question: How long have Adam and Magda been together?
questions.explanation: Adam speaks of fifteen years of marriage.

questions.question: How does Adam describe thinking about his wife?
answers: Like clicking an icon — a familiar file opens immediately
questions.explanation: He speaks of the icon on the desktop and a file known in advance.

questions.question: Why does Magda cook chicken broth?
answers: Because she feels lonely when life is predictable
questions.explanation: She admits she cooks broth when she feels loneliness and predictability.

questions.question: What does Adam ask Magda while the film is paused?
answers: Whether she sometimes thinks about separating
questions.explanation: He asks directly: do you ever think about separating?

questions.question: What does Adam write in the book at the end?
answers: That his biggest mistake was thinking he knew his wife inside out
That therapy does not work at all
That divorce is the only way out
questions.explanation: He writes about the mistake of thinking he knew his wife inside out.
